forum.title: The microcontroller STM32H725 cannot be programmed
forum.category: STM32 MCUs Boards and hardware tools
forum.best_answer_content:
Hello ​@WUDIYE and welcome to the ST community,

VFBSMPS should be connected to the ground in LDO configuration:

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/ad5563c4-01f2-4b8f-afc4-4d546013f40a.png)

From [RM0468](https://www.st.com/resource/en/reference_manual/rm0468-stm32h723733-stm32h725735-and-stm32h730-value-line-advanced-armbased-32bit-mcus-stmicroelectronics.pdf) / Figure 19. System supply configurations:

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/b02a0b94-089c-48c6-ad9f-bbd6b4c8ab27.png)
forum.content_text:
The schematic is shown below. I have pulled  down BOOT0 to ground through a jumper ， power supply voltage is normal. Could you please help me check if there is a problem with the MCU configuration。

![](https://uploads-eu-west-1.insided.com/stmicroelectronics-en/attachment/2992a797-2255-4270-94ab-bd4686e807bf.png)
